summary: Iter50 (Phase 31 — Cycle-Based Settlement Math): Verified backend + frontend for the new settlement contract. 12/12 pytest cases pass (5 new test_settlement_cycle_math + 7 existing test_finance_settlement). Frontend Settlement section on admin dashboard renders the new 5-KPI strip (Total Income, Total Contribution, Profit/Loss, Profit Share/Partner, Fair Share/Partner) and new partner columns (Contribution, Profit Share (50%), Final Share, Adjustment) for all 110 centers. Live math validated via API assertions: profit_loss = total_income − total_contribution, final_share = contribution + profit_share, adjustment = fair_share − contribution. View Settled History toggle reveals Lifetime Income / Lifetime Contribution / Lifetime P/L block, and include_history=true API returns lifetime object with all 6 required keys. Settle Dues dialog opens correctly with pre-filled recipient partner, absolute-adjustment amount, and today's date.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py _aggregate_partners_for_center now correctly returns 6-tuple; settlement_view caller unpacks 6 values — the 500-error root cause from prior iteration is fully resolved.

Response envelope for GET /api/dashboard/settlement now exposes total_contribution, total_income, profit_loss, profit_share_each, fair_share_each, partner_count on each center row and total_contribution, profit_share, final_share, fair_share, adjustment on each partner row — matches user-confirmed math.

Settlement cutoff logic verified: recording a settlement with date D excludes txns on/before D; center still returns in envelope with settled_till=D and total_contribution=0 for active cycle. include_history=true attaches a lifetime block with 6 required keys and lifetime.total_contribution retains pre-cutoff totals.

Frontend SettlementSection.jsx correctly wires all data-testids from the spec: kpi-{income,expense,pl,pshare,fair}-<cid>, p-{contrib,pshare,final}-<pid>, settle-btn-<cid>-<pid>, toggle-settled-history, settle-dialog, settle-{to-partner,amount,date,note,submit}. Adjustment column uses sign-based labels (to_pay/to_receive/settled) and Settle Dues button appears only when adjustment > 0.5.
Minor UX: Cycle Math help caption on dashboard is clear and educates end users on the formula. Good.
seed_data_creation: test_settlement_cycle_math.py creates a temporary center + 2 partners + 5 transactions via API (TEST_cycle_* prefix) at module scope. Records are left behind — recommend a cleanup fixture in a future iteration but is non-blocking (all data uses TEST_ prefix).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login redirects admin to '/' (not '/dashboard') — RoleHome renders the admin dashboard including Settlement section. Use wait_for_load_state('networkidle') after login instead of waiting for '/dashboard' URL. Sample verified math from live data: Center 'Birsa Kairo' → total_income=0, total_contribution=950, profit_loss=-950, profit_share_each=-950, fair_share_each=950 (single partner center). For Palojori Deoghar 2-partner center, sum of adjustments is zero-sum: Manisha adj=-₹29,050 (receive), Shailendra adj=+₹550 (pay). Settle Dues dialog pre-fill uses Math.abs(adjustment) so amount is the paying partner's excess-owe, not the receiver's due. include_history=true works and lifetime block has: fair_share_each, partner_count, partners, profit_loss, total_contribution, total_income.
rca of the issue: N/A — no issues found in this iteration. Previous 500 error from missing 6-tuple unpack in settlement_view is resolved.
